title: Agreements shaped by shared values
meaning: Honest conversation helps you change your agreements while respecting what matters to both of you.
text: When you discuss shared promises, precision may matter: what exactly was said, and what did each person agree to? This is Justice in the physical position of Vishuddha. The Hierophant in energy sustains a shared ethical reference point, a wish for your words to express values you both recognise. Death in emotions describes the experience of transition: an earlier formulation no longer fits and has to be released. That can feel difficult even when the revised agreement is fairer to both of you.

For example, you might reconsider a familiar promise to spend every day off together. Closeness still matters to you both, but occasionally someone needs a free day. **Commitment to a shared meaning allows the terms to change.** Instead of counting breaches, you can clarify what you are promising now and why it still cares for your connection. Agreement can take a new form that makes sense to both of you without repeating the old words.

The difficulty begins if the discussion feels like revising a document while the experience of change remains unspoken. You can reach a completely fair agreement and still feel sad about the earlier routine. In your wish to establish suitable terms quickly, you might miss that sadness. Acknowledging it allows the previous arrangement to come to an end without undoing the new decision.
